name: Demon King
source:
Regis Altare's Doppelganger

Cruelty comes to the demon king as naturally as breathing does. A tactician and a tyrant, he instills fear in all who meet him after having taken the throne of the Ice Plane by force. With both ease and elegance, the demon king was quick to dominate all lands, including the former ruling kingdom of devils, the Fire Plane. Presently unthreatened by any opposition, he now spends his days in search of other nations to conquer.

[Edited from in-game profile]
